morphology.pattern_note: 按外国人名整词处理，没有马来语词缀。规范大小写为 Akio；所列音标对应常见日语人名读音。is_root 不表示这是马来语固有词根。

senses.zh_definition: Akio，日本人名，通常用作男性名字；具体汉字写法和含义须依据本人姓名确认。
senses.en_definition: Akio, a Japanese given name, typically masculine, whose meaning depends on its written form.
senses.ms_definition: Nama orang Jepun, lazimnya nama lelaki, yang maknanya bergantung pada tulisan asalnya.
senses.nuances: 不是可据输入认定的官方马来语普通词。没有原句，不能确定它指哪一位人物、角色或账号；也不能直接指定译名为“昭夫”“明夫”或“昭雄”。马来文释义为编写释义，以下搭配是通用姓名组合，未作频率认证。[Behind the Name：Akio](https://www.behindthename.com/name/akio)

dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Akio akan membentangkan cadangan itu dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: Akio 先生将在明天的会议上介绍该提案。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Akio will present the proposal at tomorrow's meeting.

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Akio dah sampai kat lobi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Akio sudah tiba di lobi?
messages.en: Has Akio arrived in the lobby?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Aku nak turun jemput dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya akan turun untuk menyambutnya sekarang.
messages.en: Yes. I'm heading down to meet him now.

etymology.historical_story: Akio represents a Japanese name reading rather than one uniquely defined written word. Different kanji combinations can share this pronunciation, so a romanized occurrence does not establish a single meaning. When the name appears in Malay, identifying its bearer and original spelling is more reliable than assigning an attractive but unsupported translation. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/akio)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 a—ki—o 三拍记住人名，把它与具体人物的脸或名牌绑定；不要靠音译猜测汉字含义。

cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于介绍、名单和日常联系。书写为 Akio；中文姓名译法须核对本人或可靠资料，不能依据读音随意选字。
